issues.on_page: Hookup fees 55,000 (Other revenue (expense)); shown on the cash flow statement p5 as 'Cash advances for construction' 55,000 under capital and related financing
issues.issue: Hookup fees fit as charges for services. But the cash flow statement treats this money as capital-related advances, so it could be a capital contribution (business_type.other_financing) rather than operating revenue.
